Castlevania Legends.name: Castlevania Legends
Castlevania Legends.summary: Every legend has a beginning. Now discover the beginning of the Castlevania Legend in Castlevania Legends for Game Boy. In this single-player adventure, you play as Sonia Belmont, the very first in the line of vampire hunting Belmonts. Use your whip to fend off the forces of darkness, as you work your way through six stages of non-linear gameplay. Explore the legendary areas of Castlevania, including the surrounding forest and the infamous clock tower. Don't forget to collect hearts from the torches that litter the stages to gain extra lives. Adjustable difficulty settings allow you to choose the skill level at which you want to play. At the end of it all, Count Dracula himself awaits. Can you defeat him and put the evil to rest for another 100 years?

Flappy Special.name: Flappy Special
Flappy Special.summary: Flappy moves stones to get around enemies in order to reach his goal.

Jack Nicklaus Golf.name: Jack Nicklaus Golf
Jack Nicklaus Golf.summary: The biggest name in golf brings you the most realistic and feature-backed golf simulation ever! Play on two of Jack Nicklaus' favorite courses or design an unlimited number of your own. One to four players can compete on beginner and expert levels. You control every detail of the action. The password feature even lets your take a break. If you're ready to play against the best, JACK NICKLAUS GOLF is your game!
